Author: Tihlyn
Name: Keybound Assist
Description: Types the words shown over Keybound Brawler enemies at a configurable human pace and never submits a wrong word: every word is verified on screen before Enter, words taken by other players are erased, gaze casts and stuns are waited out. /kba opens the status window; it always loads disarmed.
Punchline: Human-paced, error-free typing assist for Keybound Brawler.
